Write the general term $T_{r+1}$ in the binomial expansion of $\left(x - \frac{2}{x}\right)^7$:
$$T_{r+1} = \binom{7}{r}x^{7-r}\left(-\frac{2}{x}\right)^r = \binom{7}{r}(-2)^r x^{7-2r}$$

To find the coefficient of $\frac{1}{x^3} = x^{-3}$, equate the exponent of $x$ to $-3$:
$$7 - 2r = -3 \implies 2r = 10 \implies r = 5$$

Evaluate the term for $r = 5$:
$$\binom{7}{5}(-2)^5 x^{7-10} = 21(-32)x^{-3} = -672x^{-3}$$
$$\text{Coefficient of } \frac{1}{x^3} = -672$$
